name: barony
description: Barony — git-native governance for teams of AI coding agents. Scaffold a runtime-agnostic multi-agent project: one persona.yaml hydrates working personas on any AI coding agent (Claude Code, code-puppy, pydantic-ai, ...) via per-runtime adapters. One front door (START.md → ORCHESTRATE/PARTICIPATE); the legacy v0.3 emit modes are deprecated and quarantined in legacy/. Also ships a sister skill — multi-agent-audit — for grading multi-agent projects against an evidence-based rubric (read-only). v1.5 shipped the baron CLI (ADR-003/004): validate/status/ledgers/handoffs, the baron guard PreToolUse hook, baron lock, worktree tooling, waivers. v1.6 externalizes the guard's rule table as versioned package data (capability-rules.v1.yaml), adds AGENTS.md emission to the generic adapter, and ships a fourth runtime adapter — pydantic-ai (in-process guard: sub-tool denials natively enforced) with a working hydrator (baron hydrate pydantic-ai, barony[pydantic-ai] extra). v1.7 is the rename release: the project is Barony (repo vggg/barony, package barony, skill dir skills/barony/); the CLI stays baron (ADR-005). v1.8 ships baron init (CLI 0.5.0, ADR-006) — the deterministic scaffold: canonical collab-repo layout + hydrated personas + per-persona runtime kits emitted from templates vendored as package data (drift-guarded against the skill tree), self-validated, git-committed; the conversational path keeps scope prose and Tier-3 hydration. v1.8.1 refreshes the pydantic-ai adapter HYDRATE.md for the 0.5.4 CLI interop hardening: least-privilege Shell (test-only personas get an allowlisted shell; broad shells deny redirect/pipe operators), RepoContext auto-load when a collab_root is passed, a prominent bash -c/sh -c guard-bypass honesty note, and the corrected harness/slim version range. v1.8.2 records ADR-007 (the session boundary: Barony does not own the agent execution loop — orchestration is the runtime's job — and ships thin, optional session-ritual bookkeeping primitives baron session start/end, CLI 0.5.6) and adds a 'composing the session ritual (optional)' note to the pydantic-ai adapter HYDRATE.md. v1.9.0 folds in the 2026-07-31 pilot hardening (ADR-008): a label is not evidence in either direction (the verdict comment bound to a head SHA is the record; check it before acting on an approval AND before calling a block stale), the Librarian RECORDS and RECONCILES a decision against the surfaces personas pull work from, a new check_review_feedback session-ritual token ordered before check_backlog, and a scaffolded strip-stale-verdict workflow.
